item.greenlantern.green_lantern_ring.too: Hold in either hand, or wear it in a Curios ring slot.
Toggle the Lantern Uniform to unlock the ring's powers.
Hold in your main hand while wearing the ring,
then hold the Recharge key to recite the oath.
ability.greenlantern.uniform.description: Let the ring clothe you in the uniform of the Green Lantern Corps. All other ring powers need the uniform to be active.
ability.greenlantern.ring_protection.des: The ring's life support keeps you safe from drowning, freezing and falling.
ability.greenlantern.construct_fists.des: Your punches are wrapped in hard-light constructs and hit much harder. You also gain hard-light armor.
ability.greenlantern.flight.description: Fly using the ring's power. Flying slowly drains willpower.
ability.greenlantern.willpower_beam.desc: Hold to fire a continuous beam of green light. Drains willpower while active.
ability.greenlantern.construct_blast.des: Fire a fast bolt of hard light. Costs 40 willpower.
ability.greenlantern.construct_fist.desc: Slam everything in front of you with a giant green fist, launching it into the air. Costs 100 willpower.
ability.greenlantern.construct_cage.desc: Trap the nearest creature within 12 blocks in a hard-light cage, slowing and weakening it. Costs 150 willpower.
ability.greenlantern.force_field.descrip: Toggle a protective bubble that blocks projectiles, explosions and fire. Drains willpower while active.
ability.greenlantern.ring_light.descript: Toggle the ring's glow to see in the dark.
ability.greenlantern.recharge.descriptio: With a Power Battery in your main hand, hold to recite the oath and recharge your willpower.
oath.greenlantern.line1: In brightest day, in blackest night,
oath.greenlantern.line2: No evil shall escape my sight.
oath.greenlantern.line3: Let those who worship evil's might,
oath.greenlantern.line4: Beware my power... Green Lantern's light!
